title: Hash and Yautia Hashbrowns
description: A vegetarian twist on a classic dish, using yautia and hash to create crispy hashbrowns.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated yautia, diced hash, onion, garlic, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the yautia mixture into the skillet.
Press the mixture down to form a flat shape.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the hashbrowns over and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, or until the other side is golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy.
Remove from the oven and serve hot.
